notes: The author self-describes a first-person wave survival shooter, so Shooter leads and Survival is named second in their own words. The answers turn a few streets into a lane network: the player holds one fixed central position and the undead vehicles drive in along the surrounding streets, which is exactly parallel routes channelling traffic into predictable engagement fronts, so the genre's default shape stands with the wording bent from teams to enemy vehicles. Kept PvE Shooter's spawner-npc and choke-bottleneck for the street mouths the waves arrive through, dropped building-interior because nothing says the player goes indoors, and added control-zone so the held centre the author specified exists in the layout rather than only in the fiction. With no user to ask, I read the insistence on a true 3D first-person scene as ruling out both P5 and SET — the player stands in and moves through the space — and left the run open-ended since wave survival has no finish to place.
